description: Built a full-stack e-commerce prototype using Next.js, React, Prisma, and Cloudflare Workers to support product catalog, shopping cart, and order-management workflows.
Designed and implemented 14 REST API endpoints, connecting frontend workflows with persistent backend operations and WhatsApp checkout.
Validated API behavior with Postman by testing success and error scenarios across 14 endpoints, improving reliability through iterative debugging.
Developed a backend ticket-management system using Node.js, implementing authentication, role-based access control, CRUD operations, and service-layer logic.
Designed the relational database architecture, ER models, class diagrams, and system documentation to support maintainable object-oriented development.
Created and executed API tests with Postman, validating endpoint behavior and resolving issues to improve system reliability.
Applied Agile development practices through pair programming, continuous feedback, collective code ownership, and collaborative Git/GitHub workflows.
Optimized SQL queries for a Java-based POS platform, improving query execution performance by 60% and supporting greater application scalability.
Developed and maintained unit tests using JUnit and JProfiler, helping identify approximately 40% of platform bugs earlier in the development process.
Contributed to Agile development using Scrum, Kanban, and XP practices to support iterative delivery and team collaboration.
Improved development and deployment workflows through CI/CD practices, reducing deployment time by 80%.
Modernized a web platform by implementing dynamic interfaces with React, improving the structure and maintainability of the existing application.
Refactored existing web code and implemented interactive functionality to improve the overall user experience.
Executed functional, regression, and integration testing across software projects to validate application behavior and identify defects.
Applied software quality practices and static analysis with SonarQube to identify critical code-quality issues.
Validated AI-assisted workflows using Vertex AI while documenting and reporting software issues.

back_and_frm_list: Spring Boot, Node.js, Next.js, React, REST APIs, Object-Oriented Programming, HTTP
cloud_and_system_list: Git, GitHub, Docker, Linux, Cloudflare, Azure, AWS
